in_marathi.name: Parbhakar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parbhakar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Parbhakar is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Parabhava', which means 'supreme existence' or 'supreme creator'. This name is often used to honor the divine power and creator of the universe.
